reason: S3/AC1 completes the F6 split: the migration dropped inventory_code and replaced it with separate batch_number + serial_number fields. All prior tests asserting inventory_code (its presence, segment derivation, downgrade reconstruction, and API/list absence) assert retired behavior superseded by the split; the Driver may permissively refactor only those inventory_code assertions to carry the requirement forward to batch_number/serial_number.
